shots.title: EXP-43 run 2: pieces of other maps on the blank map

marks.text: the squad starts here, each soldier on a tile of their own (six soldier spawn points brought from URB_Bar)
a dry bush (URB_GasStation_EWI): low cover, and it breaks
an abductor wall, three tiles (LAbductor_WindingStream): full cover, and it breaks
an SUV with its doors open (URB_OfficePaper_Terror): cover, burns and blows up
a moving van (URB_ResearchOutpost_EWI) with its own building: soldiers walk into its box; the roof and walls cut away
